narr: A southerly flow allowed for plenty of moisture ahead of a cold front. The moisture along with an unstable atmosphere caused heavy rain to be associated with thunderstorms, and this led to instances of flash flooding.
ev: The water level rose above flood stage along the Accotink Creek at Strathmeade Springs. The water level crested at 252.76 feet on July 1st at 11:00 PM EST, before falling below flood stage at midnight. Woodburn Road and Prosperity Avenue were flooded.
Woodburn Road was closed due to high water.
